brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: edit.delete
objective.description: Delete one or more local Brique elements from the current context tree.

#root.role: Validate one delete batch, remove the targeted local elements, and return one aggregated per-item result payload.

items._comment: Required non-empty delete batch. Each item: { type (string: context|capacity|schema|document), name (string) }.

result._comment: Per-item result list. Each item: { ok (bool), type (string), name (string) } on success, or { ok: false, type, name, error: { code, message, reason } } on failure.

effects.context_tree: Local files or directories in the current context tree may be removed.

transformation_contract.morphing: A batch of local element delete requests becomes a per-item deletion result set, with successful items removing the targeted local meaning or context state.
invariants: edit.delete is batch-oriented and returns one result entry per parsed item.
Context deletion removes a whole child context tree and updates the parent child list.
Document deletion removes the meaning descriptor and best-effort removes the local content file when the document is local.
success: On success, each result item reports ok=true with the normalized type and name of the deleted element.
Mixed batches can succeed partially because missing, unsupported, or refused items are returned as item-level errors.
failure: The capacity fails when params.items is missing or cannot be parsed into a valid edit batch.
Individual items return errors when the target is unsupported, missing, outside scope, or cannot be deleted or reflected into the parent child list.
notes: Matter and structure deletes are refused here because those element kinds are owned by MatterLoop.
Context deletion is limited to child contexts under the current context.
